title: Gewehr 300 m · A5 / A10
details: Minimum federal backing 1500 × 1650 mm. Scoring diameter 1000 mm; black diameter 600 mm. Fine diameters 100…1000 mm in 100 mm steps; A5 boundaries 200,400,600,800,1000 mm. At 7.5 m: field 25 mm, black 15 mm. Backing is white and therefore merges into A4. Stroke widths 0.65/1.2 mm full size are display choices, not specified by Annex 2. Numerals newly typeset.

title: Gewehr 300 m · B4 / B10
details: Unretouched Kuert 1269 × 1273 image mapped to its stated 1010 × 1010 mm product face (25.25 × 25.25 mm printed), within the federal minimum 1500 × 1650 mm backing. Added light-grey backing uses #d9d9d9, a display choice because the rule supplies no numeric colour. Nominal field 25 mm; bust 11.25 × 12.5 mm. Fine scoring diameters 100…1000 mm; B4: inner circle 200 mm, bust zone, 700 mm circle, 1000 mm circle. Original colour fields and contours retained. Source pixels and tiny axis normalization prevent a claim of exact contour metrology.

title: Pistole 50 m · P4 / P10
details: Official name P, not A. White field 1000 × 1000 mm, black diameter 200 mm. P10 diameters 100…1000 mm in 100 mm steps. P4 boundaries 200,300,600,1000 mm (federal drawing). Printed field 150 mm; black 30 mm; P10 ten 15 mm. Source product 1010 mm paper includes trim margin, not an enlarged scoring field. Numerals newly typeset; 0.65/1.2 mm full-size lines are rendering choices.

title: Pistole 50 m · B5 / B10
details: Unretouched Kuert 800 × 796 artwork mapped to stated 1010 × 1010 mm product face. Nominal federal field 1000 mm; bust 450 × 500 mm. Printed face 151.5 mm; nominal field 150 mm; nominal bust 67.5 × 75 mm. B5 boundaries: 150 mm circle, 300 mm circle, bust zone, 700 mm circle, 1000 mm circle; B10 uses ten concentric rings. Original colour/contour retained, including photograph/scan distortion; resolution ~134 ppi. Not a production-master vector or independently exact scoring geometry.

title: Pistole 50 m · Morgarten F100/5
details: PROVISIONAL source facsimile. Original Kromer no.18 (2026), p.9, item 753.09 stencil, no tracing or ellipse replacement. Figure envelope normalized to 450 × 1000 mm; printed 67.5 × 150 mm, card 75 × 154.5 mm (500 × 1030 mm). Native bbox 783 × 1755 pixels. Manufacturer outline/rings preserved. Centre measured from this artwork is about 406 mm above figure bottom, not the secondary 450 mm claim. Inner oval measures approximately 98 × 158 mm after envelope normalization, not a verified 100 × 150 mm. No primary dimensioned scoring master located; do not use for automatic scoring.

title: Pistole 25 m · Ordonnanz / Feldschiessen
details: Federal rectangle 450 × 760 mm with approximately 10 mm white border (470 × 780 mm card). Capsule zones, not ellipses: 10=100 × 150; 9=200 × 300; 8=300 × 450; 7=400 × 600; 6=500 × 750 mm. Semicircular ends have radius width/2; straight section height minus width. Printed black 135 × 228 mm; card 141 × 234 mm. The 150 mm-wide nominal zone 6 is intrinsically clipped by the 135 mm black width: maximum 7.5 mm each side. A4 adds no clipping. Lines 1 mm full size / 0.3 mm printed; numerals newly typeset.

title: Pistole 25 m · Precision PP10 / ISSF
details: Ring diameters 10→1: 50,100,150,200,250,300,350,400,450,500 mm; inner ten 25 mm. Black 200 mm. Printed diameters 15…150 mm in 15 mm steps; inner ten 7.5 mm; black 60 mm. 0.35 mm original ring stroke (allowed 0.2–0.5), printed 0.105 mm. Card 550 × 520 mm (permitted height up to 550 mm). SVG circles use nominal diameters at stroke centreline; stroke edge lies within published dimensional tolerances. All shapes analytic; numerals newly typeset. 2023 and October 2026 tables agree.

title: Pistole 25 m · Rapid-fire ISSF
details: Ring diameters 10→5: 100,180,260,340,420,500 mm; inner ten 50 mm. Black 500 mm. White aiming bars 125 × 5 mm each. Printed diameters 30,54,78,102,126,150 mm; inner ten 15 mm; bars 37.5 × 1.5 mm. 0.75 mm original ring stroke (allowed 0.5–1.0), printed 0.225 mm. Card 550 × 520 mm (permitted height up to 550 mm). SVG circles use nominal diameters at stroke centreline; stroke edge lies within published dimensional tolerances. All shapes analytic; numerals newly typeset. 2023 and October 2026 tables agree.

title: Pistole 50 m · PP10 / ISSF (additional distance)
details: Bonus distance preset, not a ninth distinct target design. Same ISSF geometry as 25 m precision at half its printed size. Printed black 30 mm, ten 7.5 mm, outer scoring diameter 75 mm, inner ten 3.75 mm; card 82.5 × 78 mm. Distinct from Swiss P10 despite the same printed black diameter. Same circle-centreline convention and typography as 07.
